high.decode: Top-1 equivalent; contiguous temporal patch groups, timestamps from installed qwen-vl-utils; same prompt, pixel and token digests verified across models. Compare streamed SDPA with standard generation on one OMTG clip per model.
high.metric: Macro OMTG tF1@0.5; paired resampling of source videos. Low-to-high contrasts include prompt change.

arms: exclude (old greedy SFT predictions, no GT location)
local (GT-centred allocation of up to 32 extra two-frame units)
probe.decode: E2 sample=True, temperature .7, top_p .9, top_k 0, max_new_tokens 256. Eight common seeds across arms per query. Report single-draw and eight-draw reachability and paired delta to fresh ordinary prompt.
probe.thresholds: Strong reachability >=30%; weak <15%; before committing to training compare with plain. Local and count use privileged information.

verify.frames: Up to 32 original frames within the candidate only, relative clip clock; pair padding only if odd. A candidate with no real frame or no positive answer is dropped.
verify.gate: retained precision >=45% AND all-query macro tF1 higher than E2 single dense; also report retention of 111 true additions.

cpu.width: Only shrink overlapping predictions with original centres held fixed; search best possible combination, original answer allowed
cpu.zero8: 8 original released SFT rollouts per query; match E1 event hits and E3 cohort; source frame coverage derived from E4 actual indices

scoring: Periodic; all decision gates require complete denominators.
